_comment: classifieds authorization. Public browse/detail go through the search + listing rpcs, which enforce status='active' (and owner/admin for non-active). The GENERIC /api/listings read surface is therefore NOT public: it is scoped by owner_column=seller_id so a logged-in user sees only their OWN listings (any status — their drafts/sold), and anon is denied. This closes the hole where anon could enumerate /api/listings and read other sellers' draft/removed listing content (the generic CRUD read path can't express 'active-only'). The taxonomy + geo are public (anon list/get); the catalog is admin-curated. listing_facet/listing_contact/contact_event/conversation_member/favorite are internal (admin-only direct). self_register is on for early testing; gate it for production.
_comment_chat: Chat: conversations are created via the start_conversation rpc (raw inserts, bypass policy), so create/update/delete here are admin-only; list/get scope to the user's own conversations via owner_any. conversation_member is the internal VIA membership table (admin only; the engine reads it via raw SQL). message: create is allowed for users but before() enforces conversation membership (VIA can't gate inserts); list/get use owner_via so /api reads AND realtime subscribe are scoped to the caller's conversations; messages are immutable (no update/delete).
_comment_rpc: The engine ENFORCES this _rpc whitelist (fail-closed): an unlisted or unauthorized rpc is denied (401/403) before hooks.lua runs; superusers still need the fn listed. search/category_form/listing are public via the "anon" role. The hook-side self-guards (e.g. rebuild_facets checking role=admin) are now belt-and-suspenders.
